en.headline: Man injured after being hit by tram in Causeway Bay
en.dek: A man in his 30s suffered abrasions to his arms and legs after a tram struck him near a pedestrian crossing on Yee Wo Street on Saturday afternoon; he remained conscious.
body: A man was injured when a tram struck him in Causeway Bay on Saturday afternoon. The incident occurred at about 3.55pm near 42 Yee Wo Street as a northbound tram approached a pedestrian crossing.

The man, reported to be in his 30s, fell to the ground and complained of pain in his arms and legs. Ambulance crews treated him at the scene before taking him to Ruttonjee Hospital. He remained conscious throughout.
Police sealed off part of the area for investigation. Officers are examining whether the man crossed against the lights. The tram driver was not injured.

zh.headline: 銅鑼灣電車撞傷過路男子 手腳擦傷清醒送院
zh.dek: 周六下午近4時，一輛電車在怡和街撞倒一名約30多歲男子，傷者手腳擦傷，清醒被送往律敦治醫院。
body: 銅鑼灣周六下午發生電車撞人意外。約下午3時55分，一輛往北角方向的電車駛至怡和街42號對開時，撞到一名正在過路的男子。
傷者約30多歲，倒地後表示手臂及腳部疼痛，但仍保持清醒。救護員到場為他初步治理後，送往律敦治醫院。
警方封鎖現場調查，初步不排除有人衝燈導致意外。電車司機並無受傷。
